LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ColdStartIntro: In this cold, these vehicles would not start if you needed them now. A block heater, a heated garage, a jump-start or a charged battery may get them going; better found out now than when a raid comes.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LinerSpentIntro: These vehicles' spall liners have worn through and catch nothing: a round through their armour now throws its broken pieces straight at whoever sits behind it. Load liner panels into the cargo and a mechanic will re-line it.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_WaterNoOpenWater: no river, lake or sea beside it to draw from
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingExhaustIndoo: An engine or a generator running indoors fills the room with carbon monoxide: about 70 g an hour at idle, twice that working hard. In a closed single garage that is dangerous within about an hour and a half; doors, vents and gaps in the roof let it out. With D'thorga Medical, breathing it poisons people.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CauseShortCircuit: a surge from the grid when it shorted out
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_CauseFire: a fire on the vehicle burning through it
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_ShortCircuitReached: The short circuit surged down the {VEHICLE}'s hook-up lead and shorted its wiring. Some of its circuits are dead until a mechanic repairs or patches them.
